observations: Photo 0 shows a Dell monitor displaying the Xbox home dashboard with several game tiles; underneath is a black console covered in stickers with an Xbox logo on the front right, a black Xbox controller in the foreground, and a second controller to the right.
Photo 1 shows the same monitor displaying a football match in progress, with the same black stickered console and controller setup below.
Photo 2 shows the monitor displaying the EA Sports FC 26 title screen, with the same console showing an illuminated Xbox logo and the same controller in front.
No model number, series designation, or storage capacity is visible on the console in any photo.
The console appears small and flat rather than a tall tower, but this is not conclusive from the angles shown.

claims.evidence: No model label or series name is visible on the console; 'Series 1X' is not a recognized Xbox model.
Photo 0 shows multiple on-screen tiles but the exact count and whether they are installed games cannot be confirmed.
Photo 2 shows the EA Sports FC 26 title screen on the monitor connected to the console.

claims.claim: Far Cry 3, Modern Warfare 3, Dishonored 2 and Tomb Raider installed
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows game tiles but the titles are not legible enough to confirm these specific games.

risks.risk: The console may be an Xbox Series S, Xbox One, or another model rather than a Series X; the model strongly affects value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model label or a front view showing whether a disc drive is present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lower-value Xbox Series S / disc-less model until the model is confirmed.

risks.risk: The console may have hidden faults such as overheating, port damage, software issues, or an account ban that photos cannot reveal.
risks.proof: A video of the console booting, signing in, launching a game, and a controller syncing.

risks.risk: The advertised games may be tied to a non-transferable account or may be removed after the sale.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the installed games library and account ownership details.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only with no added value for the games.

risks.risk: Stickers covering the console may hide cosmetic damage, cracks, or previous repairs.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the console with stickers removed or lifted at the edges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically damaged / unknown condition.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console model label or serial number sticker
Photo of the console front showing whether it has a disc drive
Video of the console turning on, navigating the dashboard, and launching a game
Screenshot showing the list of installed games and account details
response.reason: The Xbox model cannot be read from the photos, and the model (Series S versus Series X or older Xbox) sets the price; even a worst-case price is impossible without confirming which console is being sold.
